2122042197797462523.en_summary: Anthropic’s IPO could make about 4,250 of its 5,300 employees millionaires, per an analysis by financial platform Hill, including roughly 50 worth more than $100 million each. The estimate assumes a $1.5 trillion valuation, above the roughly $1 trillion Anthropic is now targeting.
2122042197797462523.zh_summary: Anthropic的IPO可能使約4250名（共5300名）員工成為百萬富翁，據金融平台Hill的分析，包括約50人價值超過1億美元。估計假設1.5萬億美元估值，高於Anthropic目前目標的約1萬億美元。

2122040468997275874.en_summary: They can empower their people to buy that stuff any time they want; see after GFC when Chinese stimulus & demand lifted the world out of the crisis. China just doesn't want to yet. They're playing a longer game. US is hegemon b/c we had dominant factory base in 1940.

2122039934609440858.en_summary: A small example of why China's balance of payments data is frustrating, and why the IMF needs to up its game quickly on a topic that is central to its mandate -- China's reserve growth in the q3 BoP = $47b. China's reserve growth per the PBOC balance sheet: -$0.6b.
2122039934609440858.zh_summary: 為什麼中國國際收支數據令人沮喪的一個小例子，以及為什麼IMF需要在其職責核心主題上迅速提升表現——中國第三季國際收支儲備增長=470億美元。中國人民銀行資產負債表儲備增長：-6億美元。

2122031437738070470.en_summary: "a giant wild tsunami obliterating everything in its path" A fair description of China's auto export surge. (Quoted: China will export almost 12 million vehicles this year, up more than a thousand percent since 1 million in 2020. In 2026, China’s exports alone will blow past the total number of vehicles built in America.)
2122031437738070470.zh_summary: 「一場巨大的野海嘯 obliterating 路徑上的一切」是對中國汽車出口激增的公允描述。（引用：中國今年將出口近1200萬輛車，自2020年100萬輛以來增長超過一千個百分點。2026年，中國出口單獨將超過美國製造的總車輛數。）
